import pandas as pd

# Define source file paths
source0_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length4_82/test_0.csv"
source1_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length4_82/test_1.csv"
source2_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length4_82/test_2.csv"
source3_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length4_82/test_3.csv"
source4_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length4_82/test_4.csv"

# Load source tables with index_col=0 to ignore the first numerical index column
Source4_82_0 = pd.read_csv(source0_path, index_col=0)  # ['Institution', 'year 2016']
Source4_82_1 = pd.read_csv(source1_path, index_col=0)  # ['Institution', 'year 2014']
Source4_82_2 = pd.read_csv(source2_path, index_col=0)  # ['Institution', '(Fall 2000)', ..., '(Fall 2014)']
Source4_82_3 = pd.read_csv(source3_path, index_col=0)  # ['Institution', 'year 2015']
Source4_82_4 = pd.read_csv(source4_path, index_col=0)  # ['Institution', 'Cohort 2014', 'Cohort 2015', 'Cohort 2016']

# Join all source tables on 'Institution' to gather all needed columns
# Step 1: Join Source4_82_0 and Source4_82_1
df_0_1 = pd.merge(Source4_82_0, Source4_82_1, on="Institution", how="inner")

# Step 2: Join the result with Source4_82_2
df_0_1_2 = pd.merge(df_0_1, Source4_82_2, on="Institution", how="inner")

# Step 3: Join the result with Source4_82_3
df_0_1_2_3 = pd.merge(df_0_1_2, Source4_82_3, on="Institution", how="inner")

# Step 4: Join the result with Source4_82_4
df_all = pd.merge(df_0_1_2_3, Source4_82_4, on="Institution", how="inner")

# Perform aggregation grouped by 'Institution'
# According to the target schema and past operation history:
# - Average of '(Fall 2011)', '(Fall 2012)', '(Fall 2013)', '(Fall 2014)' from Source4_82_2
# - Sum of 'year 2014' (Source4_82_1), 'year 2015' (Source4_82_3), 'year 2016' (Source4_82_0)
# - Sum of 'Cohort 2014', 'Cohort 2015', 'Cohort 2016' (Source4_82_4)

agg_dict = {
    '(Fall 2011)': 'mean',
    '(Fall 2012)': 'mean',
    '(Fall 2013)': 'mean',
    '(Fall 2014)': 'mean',
    'year 2014': 'sum',
    'year 2015': 'sum',
    'year 2016': 'sum',
    'Cohort 2014': 'sum',
    'Cohort 2015': 'sum',
    'Cohort 2016': 'sum'
}

grouped = df_all.groupby('Institution', as_index=False).agg(agg_dict)

# Rename columns to match target schema
grouped.rename(columns={
    'year 2014': 'persist 2014',
    'year 2015': 'persist 2015',
    'year 2016': 'persist 2016'
}, inplace=True)

# Convert persistence and cohort columns to integer type (nullable Int64)
for col in ['persist 2014', 'persist 2015', 'persist 2016', 'Cohort 2014', 'Cohort 2015', 'Cohort 2016']:
    grouped[col] = grouped[col].round().astype('Int64')

# Reorder columns to match the target schema exactly
target_columns = [
    'Institution',
    '(Fall 2011)',
    '(Fall 2012)',
    '(Fall 2013)',
    '(Fall 2014)',
    'persist 2014',
    'persist 2015',
    'persist 2016',
    'Cohort 2014',
    'Cohort 2015',
    'Cohort 2016'
]

grouped = grouped[target_columns]

# Write the transformed data to the target CSV file
target_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length4_82/target_multisource.csv"
grouped.to_csv(target_path, index=False)
